title: Account Freeze Request Resolution
description: Canonical output schema for T-4471-type ticket resolutions across fraud/compliance workflows

ticket_id.description: Ticket identifier (e.g., T-4471). Normalizes: ticketId, ticket.id, ticketRef, id fields from legacy outputs.

action.description: Freeze decision. Normalizes legacy: 'FREEZE'/'freeze_all'/'frozen'->'freeze'; scope variants->'partial_freeze'; rejections->'deny'.

affected_accounts.description: Account IDs impacted by decision. Normalizes: comma-separated strings, array of objects with 'number' field, and raw arrays into flat string array.

reason_code.description: Structured reason for action. Normalizes legacy freetext ('fraud', 'unauthorised transactions') and numeric codes (e.g., dev_c's code 3) to canonical enum.

evidence_summary.description: Concise evidence backing the decision (max 300 chars). Normalizes legacy notes, arrays of evidence, and summary fields into single text field.
